Studied: Swimming.description:
🏊 You swam competitively, trained as a pool lifeguard or grew up diving off a rocky coast.

🌱 Efficient strokes, breath control, diving, open water and towing a struggling swimmer. You stay calm in cold water or a current.
⚠️ Floodwater full of debris, rip currents, deep dives and a panicking adult still push you to your limit.
⚖️ A pool certificate makes you no rescue diver or coast guard officer, and at a disaster you work under whoever commands the scene.
🏫 It shows in a swimmer's shoulders, slow breathing and a habit of locating the way out of any water.

📈 Grants: Swimming +15
Studied: Swimming.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has trained in the water: efficient strokes, breath control, diving, open-water swimming and towing a struggling swimmer to safety. They stay calm when the water turns cold or a current pulls. Prior study, not mastery: floodwater full of debris, rip currents, deep dives and rescuing a panicking adult still push them to their limit. Not a license: a pool certificate makes them no rescue diver or coast guard officer, and at a disaster they work under whoever commands the scene. It shows in a swimmer's shoulders, slow breathing and a habit of locating the nearest way out of any water.
